tagline: An open-source PyTorch pipeline for training a 64M-parameter LLM from scratch

scenes.narration: Day 51: minimind claims you can train a 64M parameter LLM from scratch in about two hours on one GPU. We tested that claim.

scenes.heading: What is it?
bullets: Pure PyTorch: pretrain, SFT, LoRA, DPO, GRPO
scenes.narration: minimind implements the full LLM training pipeline in pure PyTorch, with no high level wrappers. Its README says one RTX 3090 finishes pretraining and fine tuning in about two point three hours.

steps.narration: We used the full official mini dataset and the stock defaults on an RTX 5060 Ti, changing only the epoch count to one.
The SFT script loaded the pretrained checkpoint and trained on nine hundred thousand chat examples.
Then we generated from both checkpoints with a fixed seed.

scenes.heading: What we found
scenes.caption: Pretrain 2h42m + SFT 4h37m on an RTX 5060 Ti, vs ~2.31h claimed for a 3090.
scenes.narration: Both stages finished with no errors, but took seven hours nineteen minutes, about three times the official estimate. The fine tuned model answered in chat format, yet still got facts wrong.
Full logs and code are on GitHub, Apache-2.0 licensed. Write-up linked below.
